dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the mid-dorsal and lateral surface. These feature a sharp, dark perimeter transitioning abruptly to a lighter interior. A prominent, closed 'O' annulus is located in the lower-central region of the visible torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, dark, asymmetrical pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are primarily distributed in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli, with an increased spatial concentration toward the anterior neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli form a roughly kite-shaped quadrilateral in the central flank, with the most posterior annulus acting as a vertex for a secondary triangular relationship with two smaller adjacent blobs.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a transition from large, discrete macro-annuli on the main torso to a significantly higher-frequency, smaller-scale spot pattern in the cervical transition area near the head.
